# 57 Promenade — Luxury Waterfront Apartment in Thamrin, Jakarta

> Fifty Seven Promenade is a luxury mixed-use waterfront development by PT Intiland Development Tbk, located at Jl. Teluk Betung I No. 57, Kebon Melati, Tanah Abang, Jakarta Pusat 10230. Total 496 apartment units across two towers: Sky57 (50 floors) and City57 (24 floors). Architecture by Broadway Malyan (UK). Price range from Rp 5.2 billion to Rp 27 billion (Penthouse 365 sqm). Walking distance to Grand Indonesia Mall and MRT Bundaran HI.

## Developer

PT Intiland Development Tbk (IDX: DILD), established 1983. Notable projects: South Quarter, Intiland Tower, Regatta, 1Park Hamilton.
